defects.claim: Closing a pen path with a handle drag passes empty onEnd deps to closeCurrent, so the commit inserts nothing and the drawing (or pending continuation edit) is discarded
defects.scenario: Auto-commit on, three anchors placed, press the first anchor and drag its handle to close: the drawing is discarded
defects.cause: closeCurrent called with onEnd's empty deps

defects.claim: A refused continuation join still deletes the other path, because commitJoin appends its delete op even when editOps is empty
defects.scenario: Continue an existing path onto an endpoint of a different node while finishing constraints refuse the edit: the other path disappears
defects.cause: delete op not gated on a non-empty edit
